newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Motors unveils new 3.5-litre GDI engine.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Motors unveils new 3.5-litre GDI engine.

text.p: Japan's Mitsubishi Motors Corp announced on Wednesday that it had developed a new, more fuel-efficient engine in its range of low-emission gasoline direct injection (GDI) engines.

The new engine, the V6 3.5-litre GDI engine, achieves a 30 percent improvement in fuel efficiency per mile, a 10 percent increase in power output and a 30 percent reduction in carbon dioxide emissions, compared with a standard port-injection engine, the company said.
The engine will power a new recreational vehicle (RV) model due to be launched in the near future, it added.
Mitsubishi also said it plans to introduce GDI engines in two sedan and three RV series before the end of the year.

To keep pace, the company will boost its monthly GDI engine production capacity from the current 7,000 units to 10,000 units after Japan's Golden Week holiday season in early May, and to 20,000 units in the autumn, it said.

The GDI technology has been billed as offering a way to curb the damage that cars inflict on the environment without the restrictions on freedom of motoring associated with alternative technologies, such as electric cars.
